extracted.name: Non-alcoholic espresso martini
extracted.description: Try our easy, alcohol-free espresso martini and get all the impact of the classic tipple without the booze. It's an elegant drink for a party
instruction_lines: Dry shake the first four ingredients together in a cocktail shaker, then half fill with ice. Shake hard briefly, then fine strain into a coupette or martini glass. Garnish with a coffee bean.
